modules.name: Accounting & Financial Services
modules.audience: Accountants, bankers, bookkeepers and tax professionals speaking with clients and coworkers.
modules.boundary: Professional explanations, records, meetings and client service. Country-specific tax and banking terms are labeled by jurisdiction.

lessons.title: Introduce your professional role
lessons.outcome: Explain whether you handle bookkeeping, banking, tax preparation or planning, and ask what the client needs.

lessons.title: Arrange a client meeting
lessons.outcome: Confirm the appointment, contact details, meeting format and documents to bring.

lessons.title: Identify a financial document
lessons.outcome: Distinguish a statement, invoice, receipt and tax document without treating them as interchangeable.

lessons.title: Read amounts and currencies
lessons.outcome: Say an amount, confirm its currency and repeat it back before recording it.

lessons.title: Confirm dates and periods
lessons.outcome: Ask which month, quarter or tax year a document covers.

lessons.title: Ask about income and expenses
lessons.outcome: Use simple questions to distinguish money earned from costs paid.

lessons.title: Describe an account balance
lessons.outcome: State the balance and distinguish the balance from money currently available.

lessons.title: Explain debit and credit in context
lessons.outcome: Distinguish bookkeeping entries from debit cards, credit cards and borrowing.

lessons.title: Request missing information
lessons.outcome: Ask politely for a missing statement, receipt or identifying detail through the agreed channel.

lessons.title: Close a routine client exchange
lessons.outcome: Summarize what you received, what remains missing and the next appointment.

lessons.title: Collect records for a new client
lessons.outcome: Explain your role, request a scoped document set and confirm the client's priority.

lessons.title: Classify business transactions
lessons.outcome: Discuss which category fits a purchase and ask about its business purpose.

lessons.title: Record a journal entry
lessons.outcome: Explain what an entry records and confirm its date, amount and supporting evidence.

lessons.title: Read a ledger with a coworker
lessons.outcome: Locate an entry and explain how it affects the account being reviewed.

lessons.title: Match an invoice to a payment
lessons.outcome: Compare an invoice number, payment reference, date and amount.

lessons.title: Follow up on an unpaid invoice
lessons.outcome: Ask about the expected payment date and agree how to resolve a disputed item.

lessons.title: Review bills before paying
lessons.outcome: Confirm the payee, due date, approval and amount before payment is authorized.

lessons.title: Reconcile a bank statement
lessons.outcome: Explain why the statement and ledger differ and identify outstanding transactions.

lessons.title: Discuss a bookkeeping correction
lessons.outcome: Describe the original entry, the error and the correction without blaming a colleague.

lessons.title: Explain a payroll statement
lessons.outcome: Discuss gross pay, deductions and net pay using a fictional statement.

lessons.title: Distinguish contractor and employee records
lessons.outcome: Ask which documents describe the working arrangement and identify the next review step.

lessons.title: Read an income statement
lessons.outcome: Explain revenue, expenses and profit as distinct quantities in a reporting period.

lessons.title: Read a balance sheet
lessons.outcome: Explain assets, liabilities and equity using a fictional business snapshot.

lessons.title: Discuss cash flow
lessons.outcome: Explain why recorded profit and cash available can differ.

lessons.title: Plan a business budget
lessons.outcome: Ask about expected revenue, recurring costs and a planned purchase.

lessons.title: Explain a budget variance
lessons.outcome: Compare a planned amount with an actual amount and ask why the difference occurred.

lessons.title: Prepare a monthly client update
lessons.outcome: Summarize results, unresolved questions and the next action in plain language.

lessons.title: Discuss a loan application
lessons.outcome: Ask about the loan purpose, requested amount and documents the lender has requested.

lessons.title: Explain a loan quote
lessons.outcome: Compare principal, interest, term, fees and payment schedule without confusing them.

lessons.title: Clarify collateral and guarantees
lessons.outcome: Ask what the proposed collateral or guarantee covers and request written terms.

lessons.title: Discuss a business banking fee
lessons.outcome: Locate the charge, ask what triggered it and explain the bank's stated next step.

lessons.title: Prepare for a tax-document meeting
lessons.outcome: Confirm jurisdiction, reporting period and which documents are available.

lessons.title: Distinguish deductions and tax credits
lessons.outcome: Explain the vocabulary using a clearly labeled fictional jurisdiction-specific example.

lessons.title: Discuss estimated tax payments
lessons.outcome: Ask what period a payment covers and distinguish an estimate from a final liability.

lessons.title: Ask about investment income records
lessons.outcome: Request statements showing interest, distributions or realized transactions.

lessons.title: Discuss cross-border records
lessons.outcome: Confirm currencies, dates and source records and identify a question for the relevant specialist.

lessons.title: Explain an information request
lessons.outcome: State what an auditor or reviewer requested and agree who will provide it.

lessons.title: Handoff work to a colleague
lessons.outcome: Summarize completed checks, outstanding questions and the client communication already sent.

lessons.title: Protect client information in conversation
lessons.outcome: Confirm an approved channel and decline to exchange passwords or access codes.

lessons.title: Complete a routine client case
lessons.outcome: Take a client from document intake through a clear written and spoken action summary.

lessons.title: Resolve an unexplained reconciliation difference
lessons.outcome: A missing transaction appears after the first explanation; revise the reconciliation and document the evidence.

lessons.title: Handle conflicting client records
lessons.outcome: Two documents show different amounts; identify the conflict and request the source needed to resolve it.

lessons.title: Discuss a late or incomplete submission
lessons.outcome: A deadline is approaching and records are missing; agree responsibilities and communicate the remaining uncertainty.

lessons.title: Explain a material correction to a client
lessons.outcome: A prior report needs revision; distinguish the confirmed error from effects still being reviewed.

lessons.title: Respond to an anxious tax client
lessons.outcome: A client confuses a notice with a final bill; read the document together and clarify the stated request.

lessons.title: Compare planning alternatives
lessons.outcome: Describe fictional options, assumptions, costs and tradeoffs without asserting a universal best choice.

lessons.title: Discuss a tax estimate that changed
lessons.outcome: A new income item changes the estimate; explain the changed assumption and the next review step.

lessons.title: Resolve a payroll discrepancy
lessons.outcome: An employee reports different hours; compare the time record, approval and payroll statement.

lessons.title: Handle a disputed vendor payment
lessons.outcome: A vendor says payment never arrived; verify references and agree a trace or correction process.

lessons.title: Explain a cash shortage despite profit
lessons.outcome: A business owner sees profit but cannot fund a payment; trace timing and restricted cash in the example.

lessons.title: Discuss a loan decision with conditions
lessons.outcome: Approval includes conditions; separate approved terms from items still needing confirmation.

lessons.title: Negotiate a service scope and fee
lessons.outcome: A client requests extra work; define the deliverable, exclusions, timing and quoted fee.

lessons.title: Handle an urgent client request during a handoff
lessons.outcome: A colleague is unavailable; explain what is known, what needs review and when the client will hear back.

lessons.title: Read a complex reporting note aloud
lessons.outcome: Translate technical wording into plain language and have the client explain it back.

lessons.title: Discuss an international transfer discrepancy
lessons.outcome: The recipient receives less than expected; distinguish conversion, sender fees and possible intermediary fees.

lessons.title: Explain a compliance information request
lessons.outcome: A client questions an additional document request; explain the request and its approved submission route.

lessons.title: Respond to pressure to change a record
lessons.outcome: A client asks for an unsupported entry; explain what evidence is missing and propose a documented next step.

lessons.title: Prepare a management briefing
lessons.outcome: Prioritize a fictional business's cash, reporting and deadline questions for a short meeting.

lessons.title: Teach a new coworker a review process
lessons.outcome: Explain the sequence, ask for a teach-back and correct an overlooked check respectfully.

lessons.title: Complete a complex professional case
lessons.outcome: Reconcile conflicting records, discuss a changed estimate and close with a precise client-and-team handoff.

modules.name: Personal Money & Banking
modules.audience: Individuals managing money through bank staff, banking apps, bills, saving and investing.
modules.boundary: Learn concepts and ask useful questions. Investing lessons explain products, costs, uncertainty and goals using fictional examples.

lessons.title: Name everyday money amounts
lessons.outcome: Read a price and identify the currency, banknotes and coins.

lessons.title: Ask about a bank account
lessons.outcome: Ask what an account is for and what information is needed to open it.

lessons.title: Read your balance
lessons.outcome: Distinguish current balance, available balance and a pending transaction.

lessons.title: Make a deposit
lessons.outcome: State the amount, ask when it becomes available and request confirmation.

lessons.title: Withdraw cash
lessons.outcome: Request an amount, choose denominations and count the cash received.

lessons.title: Use a debit or credit card
lessons.outcome: Ask which card type is accepted and identify which account or bill a purchase affects.

lessons.title: Find a transaction in an app
lessons.outcome: Locate the amount, date, merchant and payment status on a fictional screen.

lessons.title: Identify income and spending
lessons.outcome: Describe money coming in and regular payments going out.

lessons.title: Set a simple savings goal
lessons.outcome: State what you are saving for, how much you need and when you hope to reach it.

lessons.title: Ask for help clearly
lessons.outcome: Explain one money question, ask for a slower explanation and confirm the next step.

lessons.title: Open and compare bank accounts
lessons.outcome: Ask about fees, minimum balances, access and account features.

lessons.title: Understand monthly account fees
lessons.outcome: Locate a fee, ask why it was charged and request the written conditions.

lessons.title: Choose a direct-deposit account
lessons.outcome: Confirm the account details to provide through an approved channel.

lessons.title: Deposit a check
lessons.outcome: Ask about endorsement, processing time and when funds may be available.

lessons.title: Use an ATM
lessons.outcome: Ask about withdrawal limits, fees and a machine that did not dispense cash.

lessons.title: Transfer money between your accounts
lessons.outcome: Confirm source, destination, amount and processing status before submitting.

lessons.title: Send money to another person
lessons.outcome: Confirm the recipient and amount, and ask how mistakes are handled.

lessons.title: Read a bank statement
lessons.outcome: Match opening balance, money in, money out, fees and closing balance.

lessons.title: Manage a pending card charge
lessons.outcome: Ask when a pending transaction may settle and how a hold differs from a final charge.

lessons.title: Discuss an overdraft or insufficient funds
lessons.outcome: Ask what happened, what fee applies and which account settings are available.

lessons.title: Report a lost card
lessons.outcome: Explain when the card was last used and ask about freezing and replacement.

lessons.title: Question an unfamiliar transaction
lessons.outcome: Identify the transaction and ask the bank about its dispute process.

lessons.title: Use a banking app with support
lessons.outcome: Describe an error message and ask for an approved recovery route without sharing access codes.

lessons.title: Set up recurring bills
lessons.outcome: Confirm the payee, amount, frequency, start date and cancellation method.

lessons.title: Cancel or change an automatic payment
lessons.outcome: Ask what must be changed with the bank and what must be changed with the merchant.

lessons.title: Build a monthly budget
lessons.outcome: Separate take-home income, fixed bills, flexible spending and a planned saving amount.

lessons.title: Handle an irregular income month
lessons.outcome: Explain a lower-income month and compare possible changes to upcoming spending.

lessons.title: Compare purchase prices
lessons.outcome: Compare total cost, unit price, delivery fees and discounts in a fictional offer.

lessons.title: Understand installment payments
lessons.outcome: Ask about the full price, payment dates, fees and consequences of a missed payment.

lessons.title: Read a credit-card statement
lessons.outcome: Distinguish statement balance, minimum payment, due date and interest charges.

lessons.title: Understand interest in plain language
lessons.outcome: Explain how a stated rate and a period affect a fictional example.

lessons.title: Compare loan offers
lessons.outcome: Ask about the amount received, total repayment, fees, term and quoted payment.

lessons.title: Understand a credit report
lessons.outcome: Ask what information appears, who supplied it and how an error can be challenged.

lessons.title: Plan an emergency fund
lessons.outcome: Discuss essential expenses, an accessible reserve and a realistic contribution.

lessons.title: Compare saving and investing
lessons.outcome: Distinguish access, potential return and the possibility of losing invested money.

lessons.title: Understand shares, bonds and funds
lessons.outcome: Ask what the asset represents and explain basic differences without promising returns.

lessons.title: Ask about investment fees and diversification
lessons.outcome: Ask how charges work and explain why holding several assets differs from holding one.

lessons.title: Discuss retirement-account vocabulary
lessons.outcome: Ask about contributions, access rules and employer features for a clearly named example jurisdiction.

lessons.title: Prepare questions for a financial professional
lessons.outcome: State a goal, time horizon, cash needs and questions about services and compensation.

lessons.title: Complete a personal money review
lessons.outcome: Explain a fictional household budget, bank concern, saving goal and investment questions.

lessons.title: Resolve an ATM cash mismatch
lessons.outcome: The machine reports success but less cash appears; state the facts and request the bank's next step.

lessons.title: Handle a delayed transfer
lessons.outcome: A recipient has not received funds; compare reference, destination and bank-stated processing time.

lessons.title: Resolve a duplicate debit
lessons.outcome: Two settled charges appear; distinguish them from a temporary authorization and ask about correction.

lessons.title: Explain suspected account misuse
lessons.outcome: Describe unfamiliar activity, use an official contact route and request appropriate account controls.

lessons.title: Deal with a convincing payment scam
lessons.outcome: A message demands urgent payment; verify the claimed request through a separate trusted channel.

lessons.title: Question an investment promise
lessons.outcome: Ask about risk, fees, access to funds and the basis for a promised result.

lessons.title: Handle a sudden income change
lessons.outcome: A paycheck stops; explain the change and discuss a revised fictional budget.

lessons.title: Discuss difficulty making a payment
lessons.outcome: Contact the provider, explain the situation and ask what arrangements it offers.

lessons.title: Review a debt-repayment proposal
lessons.outcome: Compare payment amount, term, interest and total cost using fictional written terms.

lessons.title: Resolve a subscription renewal dispute
lessons.outcome: Identify the renewal, cancellation record and requested resolution.

lessons.title: Discuss a shared household budget
lessons.outcome: Negotiate how two people split bills and handle an unexpected expense.

lessons.title: Talk about a financial boundary
lessons.outcome: Decline a request for money respectfully and explain the limit you are setting.

lessons.title: Review fees before moving an account
lessons.outcome: Ask about closure, transfer and service fees and confirm what changes automatically.

lessons.title: Explain a market decline without panic language
lessons.outcome: Describe a fictional portfolio change and separate price movement from a guaranteed outcome.

lessons.title: Discuss a goal with competing time horizons
lessons.outcome: Compare short-term access needs with a longer-term goal and formulate questions for an adviser.

lessons.title: Compare borrowing for a large purchase
lessons.outcome: Clarify the deposit, financed amount, quoted rate and total payments across fictional offers.

lessons.title: Handle a benefits or tax-related document question
lessons.outcome: Identify the document and jurisdiction and prepare questions for the appropriate specialist.

lessons.title: Support a family member at the bank
lessons.outcome: Clarify the person's request and distinguish assistance with language from authority to act.

lessons.title: Explain a money decision to someone else
lessons.outcome: State the goal, alternatives, assumptions and remaining questions in ordinary language.

lessons.title: Complete a complex household case
lessons.outcome: Resolve a transaction issue, revise a budget after an income change and prepare investment questions.

modules.name: Travel Money & Payments
modules.audience: Travelers paying for goods and services, exchanging currency and resolving payment questions.
modules.boundary: The money changing hands: price, currency, amount tendered, change, fees, holds, refunds and payment evidence. Existing hotel and transport courses retain their broader travel conversations.

lessons.title: Ask how much something costs
lessons.outcome: Ask a price, identify the currency and repeat the amount back.

lessons.title: Read prices and decimal amounts
lessons.outcome: Distinguish whole currency units from smaller units using a clearly stated local notation.

lessons.title: Recognize banknotes and coins
lessons.outcome: Ask what each denomination is worth and choose the amount you need.

lessons.title: Ask whether cash or card is accepted
lessons.outcome: Confirm payment methods before making a purchase.

lessons.title: Pay with a larger banknote
lessons.outcome: State the amount handed over and ask whether the seller can change it.

lessons.title: Count and confirm your change
lessons.outcome: Subtract a simple purchase from a fictional cash payment and confirm the change aloud.

lessons.title: Ask for a receipt
lessons.outcome: Request proof of payment and check the amount, date and currency.

lessons.title: Ask what is included in a price
lessons.outcome: Ask whether the quoted amount includes taxes, fees or a particular item.

lessons.title: Ask about a discount
lessons.outcome: Ask politely whether a lower price is available and accept or decline the answer.

lessons.title: Complete a small cash purchase
lessons.outcome: Confirm the price, hand over cash, check change and close the exchange.

lessons.title: Exchange cash at a counter
lessons.outcome: State the currencies and amount and ask what net amount you will receive.

lessons.title: Read an exchange-rate quote
lessons.outcome: Confirm which currency buys which and whether the quote includes a fee.

lessons.title: Compare two exchange offers
lessons.outcome: Compare the final amount received for the same fictional starting amount.

lessons.title: Withdraw local currency at an ATM
lessons.outcome: Ask about the bank's displayed fee, withdrawal amount and currency choice.

lessons.title: Choose the currency for a card payment
lessons.outcome: Ask who performs conversion, what rate is quoted and what charges are disclosed.

lessons.title: Manage cash denominations for a day
lessons.outcome: Ask for smaller notes and divide a stated budget between planned purchases.

lessons.title: Pay for a taxi
lessons.outcome: Confirm the fare basis, payment method and any disclosed extras before departure.

lessons.title: Ask about a taxi fare difference
lessons.outcome: Compare the meter or agreed fare with the amount requested at arrival.

lessons.title: Pay through a ride-hailing app
lessons.outcome: Identify the amount charged in the app and ask whether another cash payment is required.

lessons.title: Buy public-transport tickets
lessons.outcome: Ask the fare, number of journeys, validity and final price before paying.

lessons.title: Pay for a hotel stay
lessons.outcome: Confirm the total, currency, included services and payment timing.

lessons.title: Understand a hotel deposit or card hold
lessons.outcome: Ask whether money is charged or temporarily reserved, and when it may be released.

lessons.title: Check a hotel bill
lessons.outcome: Match room charges and listed extras to the booking and request an itemized explanation.

lessons.title: Pay for a rental car
lessons.outcome: Ask about the rental price, deposit, payment card and charges included in the quote.

lessons.title: Discuss a rental fuel charge
lessons.outcome: Compare the stated fuel terms with the amount on the return receipt.

lessons.title: Ask about a rental toll or parking fee
lessons.outcome: Ask which provider charged the fee and whether an administration charge is separate.

lessons.title: Pay a restaurant bill
lessons.outcome: Confirm service charges, tips and the final amount before paying.

lessons.title: Split a bill
lessons.outcome: Agree which items or amount each person pays and confirm separate receipts if needed.

lessons.title: Bargain at a market
lessons.outcome: Ask for a better price, clarify quantity and currency and decide whether to buy.

lessons.title: Compare a cash price and a card price
lessons.outcome: Ask why the totals differ and confirm the price before choosing a method.

lessons.title: Pay a booking deposit
lessons.outcome: Confirm the deposit, remaining balance, due date and written cancellation terms.

lessons.title: Ask about a refund
lessons.outcome: State what was paid, request the refund terms and ask how and when money is returned.

lessons.title: Make a refundable reservation
lessons.outcome: Distinguish the booking price from a refundable option and request the exact written terms.

lessons.title: Change a travel booking
lessons.outcome: Compare the new price, change fee and any remaining credit.

lessons.title: Purchase a tour or attraction ticket
lessons.outcome: Ask which costs are included and what must be paid separately on arrival.

lessons.title: Pay for laundry or another local service
lessons.outcome: Confirm whether the price is per item, weight, hour or load and ask for the total.

lessons.title: Send or receive travel money
lessons.outcome: Confirm the recipient, payout amount, fee, currency and expected availability.

lessons.title: Keep a daily travel-money record
lessons.outcome: Explain what was paid, what remains available and which expenses are still pending.

lessons.title: Ask about a local visitor tax
lessons.outcome: Confirm the amount, who collects it, payment timing and the receipt provided.

lessons.title: Complete a routine travel-payment day
lessons.outcome: Handle cash, a transport fare, a hotel hold and an itemized meal bill.

lessons.title: Resolve short change politely
lessons.outcome: The change received differs from your calculation; state the payment and price and recount together.

lessons.title: Resolve a misunderstood currency
lessons.outcome: The seller and traveler quoted different currencies; clarify before confirming the purchase.

lessons.title: Handle a card decline at checkout
lessons.outcome: Ask what the message says, whether anything was charged and which alternative is accepted.

lessons.title: Handle a duplicate travel charge
lessons.outcome: Compare receipts and settled transactions and request the merchant's correction process.

lessons.title: Challenge an undisclosed extra
lessons.outcome: A new fee appears after a quote; ask what it covers and refer to the agreed price.

lessons.title: Resolve a hotel deposit delay
lessons.outcome: Ask whether the hotel released the hold and what confirmation your bank may need.

lessons.title: Dispute a hotel room extra
lessons.outcome: A minibar or service item appears on the bill; identify the item and request a review.

lessons.title: Discuss a rental-car damage charge
lessons.outcome: Request the inspection record, itemized amount and stated dispute process.

lessons.title: Compare a changed rental quote
lessons.outcome: A counter offer changes the booking price; separate optional additions from required charges.

lessons.title: Handle a taxi payment disagreement
lessons.outcome: A driver requests more than the quoted or metered amount; clarify each listed extra and the receipt.

lessons.title: Handle a changed exchange quote
lessons.outcome: The final cash offered differs from the quote; stop and ask for the rate and fee calculation.

lessons.title: Explain an ATM fee or conversion surprise
lessons.outcome: Separate the withdrawal amount, ATM fee and displayed conversion choice using the receipt.

lessons.title: Negotiate a purchase with several conditions
lessons.outcome: Discuss quantity, delivery, included accessories and total price without losing the currency or payment terms.

lessons.title: Arrange a partial refund
lessons.outcome: Agree what portion is being refunded, any retained charge, the currency and payment route.

lessons.title: Cancel a prepaid booking
lessons.outcome: Refer to the booking's written terms and ask about the amount returned and timing.

lessons.title: Handle a travel-app refund credit
lessons.outcome: Distinguish a cash refund from app credit and ask about restrictions and expiry.

lessons.title: Report a lost wallet while traveling
lessons.outcome: Explain what is missing and ask official providers about card replacement and access to funds.

lessons.title: Request a payment accommodation
lessons.outcome: Ask about splitting payment across cash and card or paying a stated balance later.

lessons.title: Explain an exchange calculation to a companion
lessons.outcome: State the quote direction, starting amount, fee and final amount using fictional numbers.

lessons.title: Complete a complex travel-money case
lessons.outcome: Resolve a hotel hold, a changed taxi total and an exchange quote, keeping amounts and evidence clear.
